adjudication.rationale: `parseRefreshTokenResponse` explicitly sets `refreshTokenResponse.data.refresh_token = "refresh_token"` when the parsed response lacks a refresh token (line ~25). When credential syncing is enabled (`APP_CREDENTIAL_SHARING_ENABLED` + `CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT`), the function uses `minimumTokenResponseSchema`, so a sync endpoint that returns only `access_token`/expiry will trigger this placeholder. Call sites then persist the result into DB in ways that can overwrite the real refresh token, e.g. `office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` spreads `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` and then `prisma.credential.update({ data: { key: o365AuthCredentials } })`, which would store `refresh_token: "refresh_token"` and clobber the prior valid refresh token.
